setup.zh: 你翻出院墙，冲上后山。崖边有一块大青石，比你还高。你把那股暖，一点一点引到胳膊上——一拳。
setup.en: You vault the wall and race up the mountain. At the cliff's edge stands a blue boulder taller than you. You draw the warmth, bit by bit, into your arm — and punch.

recap.zh: 你一拳打裂了后山崖顶的大青石，然后把笑声咽了回去。那一夜你在崖顶坐到天亮：「娘。门开了。」
recap.en: One punch split the blue boulder on the cliff top; then you swallowed your laughter. You sat there till dawn: "Ma. The gate's open."

zh: 崖边一块大青石，比你还高。
en: At the cliff's edge, a blue boulder taller than you.
A split, from top to bottom.

story.zh:
小满从柴堆上跳下来。

说是跳，其实是飘。他往下一跳，身子轻得像一片叶子，两只脚落在地上，竟没有一点声音，连墙根底下那只蛐蛐都没惊着。他站在那里愣了一愣，低头瞧瞧自己的脚，又抬头瞧瞧那道院墙——一丈来高，平时他得踩着柴堆才翻得过去。

他退后两步，往前一蹿，两只手在墙头上一搭，人已经翻了出去。

墙外是后山。他一口气冲了上去。风在耳边呼呼作响，路两旁的树一棵一棵往后倒，脚底下的石头、树根、坑洼，他看也不看，两条腿自己便知道该往哪里落。一道他白天要绕半里地的山涧，他想也没想，一步便跨了过去；跨过去了，才回过头来看，那山涧足有两丈宽，涧底的水哗哗地响。

他站在涧边，一颗心砰砰直跳，跳得比刚才撞那第三道门还响。

一直冲到崖顶，他才停下来，弯着腰大口喘气。这一回喘，是真喘，不是装的。他喘着喘着，自己先笑了：一个人装了一年喘，今天总算真喘了一回，喘得还挺痛快。

崖边有一块大青石，比他还高出一头，也不知在那里蹲了几百年，石面上长满了青苔，底下给雨水冲出了一道一道的沟。小满盯着它，心里砰砰直跳。

他攥紧拳头，把身子里那股转圈的暖一点一点往胳膊上引。那股暖起先不大听话，在丹田里转得好好的，给他一引，便往回缩，像一只刚抓来的小狗，不肯出窝。他引了三回，第三回，它才慢吞吞地顺着胳膊爬了上来，爬到拳头上，热烘烘的。

他一拳打了出去。

只听得「咔」的一声，青石上裂开了一道缝，从他拳头落下的地方，一直裂到了石头底。石面上的青苔给震得簌簌往下掉，落了他一脚。

他看看那道缝，又看看自己的拳头。拳头上连一点皮都没破。
story.en:
Xiaoman jumped down from the woodpile.

Jumped, they'd call it — really he floated. He jumped and his body was as light as a leaf; both feet touched the ground without a sound, not even startling the cricket at the foot of the wall. He stood there stunned a moment, looked down at his feet, then up at the court wall — a good ten feet high; usually he had to climb the woodpile to get over it.

He stepped back two paces, sprang forward, put both hands on the top of the wall, and was over.

Beyond the wall was the back mountain. He ran up it in one breath. Wind whistled past his ears, the trees on either side fell away behind him one by one; the stones, roots and holes under his feet he never looked at — his legs knew where to land. A gully he had to go half a li round by day he crossed in a single stride without a thought; only afterwards did he look back — it was a good twenty feet across, water roaring at the bottom.

He stood at the edge of the gully, his heart pounding louder than when he'd broken the third gate.

Only at the top of the cliff did he stop, bent over, gulping air. This time the gasping was real, not put on. Gasping, he started to laugh: a whole year pretending to be out of breath, and today at last he was, and it felt wonderful.

At the cliff's edge stood a great blue boulder, a head taller than he was, squatting there who knew how many hundred years, its face grown over with moss, its foot channelled by rain. Xiaoman stared at it, his heart thudding.

He clenched his fist and drew the circling warmth in his body, little by little, into his arm. At first it wouldn't obey — it had been circling nicely in his belly, and when he pulled, it shrank back like a puppy just fetched home that won't leave its nest. He pulled three times, and on the third it crept, slow and reluctant, up his arm and into his fist, warm and glowing.

He punched.

There was a crack, and a seam split the boulder from where his fist landed right down to its base. Moss shaken loose from the face pattered down over his feet.

He looked at the seam, then at his fist. Not a scrap of skin broken.

label.en: Stuff your fist in your mouth

exits.means: keeps silent, bites the fist, hides the joy

story.zh:
他想笑，张开嘴，正要冲着整座沉鼎山喊上一嗓子——他想喊什么，自己也不知道，大约是「你爷爷的」，也可能是「娘」——话到喉咙口，却一下子把拳头塞进了嘴里。

他咬着自己的拳头，蹲在那块裂开的青石后面，笑得浑身发抖，眼泪都笑了出来，愣是一点声音也没出。一边笑，一边在心里念：「藏。藏，藏，藏……」
story.en:
He wanted to laugh. He opened his mouth to shout across the whole of Chending Mountain — what, he didn't know himself, maybe "Your grandfather's —!", maybe "Ma!" — and with the words in his throat he stuffed his fist into his mouth.

Biting his own fist, he crouched behind the split boulder and laughed till he shook all over and tears ran, without making a single sound. And as he laughed he recited in his heart: "Hide. Hide, hide, hide…"

exits.means: shouts for joy over the mountain

story.zh:
他想笑，张开嘴，冲着整座沉鼎山，「嗷——」地喊了一嗓子。那一嗓子在山谷里撞来撞去，撞了七八个来回，惊起一树的老鸹。

喊完了，他才想起那个字来，一缩脖子，蹲在那块裂开的青石后面，捂住了自己的嘴。山下外门的院子里，有人推开窗子骂了一句「哪来的狼」，又把窗子关上了。

他蹲在石头后面，笑得浑身发抖，一边笑，一边在心里念：「藏。藏，藏，藏……下回，藏。」
story.en:
He wanted to laugh. He opened his mouth and, across the whole of Chending Mountain, let out one great "Aoooo—!" The shout banged back and forth in the valley seven or eight times and startled a whole tree of crows into the air.

Only when it was done did he remember that word. He ducked, crouched behind the split boulder, and clapped a hand over his mouth. Down in the outer court someone pushed open a window, swore "Where's that wolf from?", and shut it again.

He crouched behind the stone, laughing till he shook, and as he laughed he recited in his heart: "Hide. Hide, hide, hide… next time — hide."
